stem: What happens next in this passage after “He said, 'It reminds me that time is not only numbers.'”?
options: On the first night, I wanted to go home because the room was dark and everyone was new.
Lena thought this was silly until she learned that 3:17 was the time their family had arrived at their new home years ago.
While the young man fixed the guitar, the old man told a short story about his band many years ago.
Grandpa thought for a long time and said, "The number of the bus I took to meet your grandmother."
